title: A low-rank probe recovered motion-state information from frozen 3D features
summary: A fitted rank-eight probe on frozen π³X features reached 91.67% balanced accuracy when classifying whether token pairs shared a motion state. Shuffling training labels reduced balanced accuracy to 50.34%. The result is specific to this probe and these recordings.
organization: Technical University of Munich; Munich Center for Machine Learning; Obsphera

source_review.scope: v1 rank-restricted probing, Table 5 and Appendix D.3

evidence.tested: The test compared probes with matched or within-frame shuffled targets on YouTube-VOS validation pairs.
evidence.unknown: Semantic content and object identity can contribute to the signal. The test does not establish an intrinsic motion basis.
evidence.ai_role: Matched and shuffled motion labels trained low-rank quadratic probes on frozen π³X visual tokens.
